title: Big Dog Fishing Charters
specs: Fishing in Barataria Basin waterways known for abundant fish and wildlife
Captains have 30+ years of experience and are fully ISCG licensed and insured
Each person 18 years and older must have a Louisiana fishing license purchased online prior to arrival
Fishing license and State ID required
Most captains fish a maximum of 4 anglers per boat; some boats can take 5 people (adults and children mix)
Bow fishing boats accommodate up to 6 people; multiple boats available for larger groups
Can take out groups up to 20 people

blurb: Guests fish in Louisiana waterways targeting species like redfish, speckled trout, drum, flounder, and sheephead. Charters include rods, reels, tackle, bait, and cleaning and bagging of catch. Lodging options include private cabins and homes with kitchens and waterfront docks.
extraNote: Full payment due upon completion of fishing trip · Ten day cancellation requested · Trips subject to cancellation by captain due to severe weather; reschedule or refund offered
